profile.headline: Software Developer @TraxID
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and modernizing enterprise software systems, primarily with C#/.NET, React, SQL Server, and Java.
 
My experience started in Java backend development and has grown into end-to-end ownership of full-stack systems. Today, my work goes beyond implementing individual features—I’m involved in how applications are architected, how components interact, how they’re tested and deployed, and how technical decisions translate into reliable production systems.
 
At TraxID, I architected and built a React/.NET Core enterprise platform to modernize legacy ASP.NET WebForms applications. I designed the backend structure using Clean Architecture and Modular Monolith principles and worked across APIs, business logic, data access, authentication and authorization, logging, frontend integration, and SQL Server.
 
I’ve also taken ownership of the engineering practices around the software itself. This has included migrating repositories from SVN to GitHub, establishing Git workflows, building Jenkins deployment automation, improving testing and release processes, and helping engineers adopt consistent development practices.
 
As my role has grown, so has the leadership side of my work. I’ve led technical execution across multiple projects, provided technical direction to engineering teams, mentored and onboarded developers, and worked directly with enterprise customers to turn complex operational requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.
 
What I enjoy most is taking a complex problem from “How should we build this?” to a system that works reliably in production. I’m especially interested in backend and full-stack engineering, software architecture, system design, and building maintainable systems that can evolve over time.
 
Core technologies: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, React, JavaScript, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, REST APIs, Git/GitHub, Jenkins, and IIS.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Architected and built a React/.NET Core 7 enterprise platform from the ground up, using Modular Monolith and Clean Architecture patterns to modernize legacy ASP.NET WebForms systems and support independently structured business modules.
 
• Designed backend architecture across Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers using Repository/Service patterns, dependency injection, async programming, Entity Framework Core, REST APIs, JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and Serilog.
 
• Led end-to-end engineering across multiple enterprise platforms, owning architecture, frontend/backend development, system integration, testing, releases, and production delivery.
 
• Designed MWS workflows spanning authentication, device provisioning, job processing, submission, and work-order completion, including shared domain contracts across .NET backend and Windows applications.
 
• Modernized engineering workflows by migrating 10+ SVN repositories to GitHub with history preserved, establishing Git Flow and Git submodules, supporting GitHub Actions, and building Jenkins deployment automation.
 
• Established systematic UI, scenario, regression, negative, backend, and database testing across state transitions, permissions, malformed inputs, data integrity, and cross-feature impacts.
 
• Led technical execution across teams of up to 12 members, providing technical direction, mentoring engineers, resolving blockers, and coordinating concurrent initiatives.
 
• Served as a primary technical interface for an enterprise customer, translating operational requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and validation scenarios.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed enterprise web applications using C#, ASP.NET/.NET, JavaScript, and SQL Server, contributing to both application and database design and implementation.
 
• Troubleshot and resolved issues across application code, database logic, and business workflows while performing functional and system-level testing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Backend development and system design for enterprise workforce-management and file-server migration systems using Java, Spring, and Oracle.
 
• Improved search performance by 2x by optimizing database queries processing approximately 100,000 records.
 
• Built automated performance-testing and deployment workflows using JMeter and Jenkins, reducing repetitive testing and deployment effort.
